name: Each load readout names what it shows

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve.
Verify the EV charger row shows an energy figure with a 'by slot' sub-label giving its deadline, a power figure with a sub-label giving how many slots it occupies, and the three controls.
Verify the sub-label under the power figure states a slot count in the form 'N slots'.
